description: Pre-promo tape lookup for a Solana token when we hold a locked [-60m,0] window around its DexScreener paid-promo timestamp (specialty covered shelf, not a universal catalog). Returns raw aggregates only: net buy USD, unique buyers, largest buyer share, and the same stats vs a matched-null mean from other covered tokens (intensity-tercile leave-one-out). Uncovered token -> 404 with coverage:false and the live coverage rate — never fabricated numbers. Free coverage probe: GET /v0/solana/pre-promo-coverage. Not financial advice; no wallet-to-person attribution. PAID: $0.01 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/solana/pre-promo.
name: solana_pre_promo
title: Solana pre-promo covered-shelf aggregates vs matched null
